brand.name: Elder World Studio
brand.about: Elder World Studio Inc is a game development studio that blends the enchanting aesthetics of medieval worlds with the power of modern technology. We make PC and mobile games, and assets for other developers.

games.title: Astro Dodge
games.text: Steer your ship through an endless field of asteroids, grab power-ups and chase your best score.

games.title: Star Wayfarer
games.text: An open space adventure built for mobile. Fly, trade, mine and fight across the stars, land on planets, and build your crew, fleet and empire.

games.title: Omnivael: Wayfarer's Life
games.text: A living sandbox RPG where your legacy unfolds through trade, exploration, relationships and time itself, in a medieval frontier whose economy runs on its people.

games.title: Chronicles of the Realm
games.text: A free first-person dungeon game set in the world of Omnivael. Take up sword and shield, survive wave after wave of slimes and goblins in a torch-lit cave, and pick a boon between waves.
games.alt: Chronicles of the Realm: fighting slimes in a torch-lit cave arena

games.title: Tile 2048
games.text: Slide and merge numbered tiles to reach 2048.

games.title: Brick Blitz
games.text: Bounce the ball, break neon bricks, and clear arcade levels.

games.title: Color Gate
games.text: Match your color to pass through the right gates.

games.title: Crystal Merge
games.text: Merge glowing crystals, make combos, and grow your score in a neon puzzle.

games.title: Gem Hopper
games.text: Tap to hop between floating gems and build your best score.

games.title: Neon Snake
games.text: The classic snake game, in neon.

games.title: Spiral Drop
games.text: Drop down the spiral tower without hitting the hazards.

games.title: Stack Tower
games.text: Time your taps to stack blocks as high as you can.

games.title: Void Flip
games.text: Tap to reverse gravity and guide a neon probe through energy gates.

services.title: Free demo first
services.text: Tell us what you need. We build a quick, free demo of it for your business and share it by link. You only decide on anything after you’ve seen it working. No pressure and no obligation.

services.title: Websites
services.text: New sites, refreshes and fixes: mobile-friendly pages, online booking, menus, quote forms and simple online stores.

services.title: AI tools & chat assistants
services.text: A chat assistant on your site that answers questions from your hours, menu and prices 24/7, takes requests and emails real leads to you.

services.title: Automation
services.text: Stop retyping things. We connect forms, email, spreadsheets and the tools you already use so routine work happens on its own.

services.title: Custom software & dashboards
services.text: Internal tools, client portals and dashboards that replace paper forms and messy spreadsheets.
